subject: Split technical & exec session to match CTO transit
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
To: Alice Nguyen <alice@helios.com>, Tom Reed <tom.reed@helios.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>, Diego Fernandez <diego@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 26 Sep 2026 16:08:00 -0700
Subject: Proposed 90m demo next Wed — CTO attendance?

Hi Alice / Tom,

Thanks again for the interest — excited to walk Helios through Redwood. Proposed plan for next Wednesday (Oct 6): 90 minutes total, technical deep-dive (60m) followed by an exec summary / economics (30m). Draft agenda attached (agenda.pdf).

Quick asks so we can lock the invite:
- Will your CTO be joining the main window? If not, do they have a small window earlier/later?
- Any execs (VP-level) who should be in the 30m summary?
- Any items we must include in the MAP or procurement checklist?

We can split the session if that makes it easier (tech first, exec separate). Monica will lead the pricing/cost discussion and Diego will do the perf deep-dive.

If you confirm CTO timing, I’ll send updated invites and the mutual action plan.

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
karthik@redwood.com | (415) 555-0192

Attachment: agenda.pdf
From: Alice Nguyen <alice@helios.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Tom Reed <tom.reed@helios.com>
Cc: Mariana Lee <mariana@helios.com>
Date: Sat, 26 Sep 2026 19:42:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Proposed 90m demo next Wed — CTO attendance?

Karthik — thanks for the agenda. Quick heads up on logistics: our CTO (Ethan Park) is arriving on an overnight international flight and his ETA is 08:00 local on Oct 6. He won’t be able to join a 10:00–11:30 PT session.

We do have Mariana Lee (VP Product) who can join the main window, and she’d like the exec-level economics piece. If possible, Ethan would prefer a short focused session later the same day (around 13:30–14:00 PT) or a brief 30-minute sync the following morning. I’ve attached Ethan’s travel itinerary for reference (travel_itinerary.pdf).

Two asks from our side: can you record both segments and share the MAP ahead of time? Also — our procurement lead needs any SOC2 or compliance summary docs before demo (quick checklist will do).

If splitting is easiest, we’d prefer:
- 10:00–11:00 PT: technical deep-dive (Mariana will attend)
- 13:30–14:00 PT: CTO + exec summary (Ethan will join)

Let me know if that works and we can confirm.

Best,
Alice Nguyen
Head of Platform Partnerships | Helios Systems
alice@helios.com

Attachment: travel_itinerary.pdf
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
To: Alice Nguyen <alice@helios.com>, Tom Reed <tom.reed@helios.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>, Diego Fernandez <diego@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 26 Sep 2026 20:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Proposed 90m demo next Wed — CTO attendance?

Thanks Alice — that itinerary helps. Splitting is fine and actually preferable for clarity. Proposed updated plan:

- 10:00–11:00 PT: Technical deep-dive (Diego leads kernel/runtime perf, 40m demo + 20m Q&A) — Mariana and product/eng invited.
- 13:30–14:00 PT: Exec summary (Monica leads pricing, ROI scenarios, 15m Q&A) — CTO and VP attendees.

I attached an updated agenda (agenda-v2.pdf) reflecting the split and the MAP checklist we’ll send ahead of time. We’ll record both sessions and upload the recording and notes to the Drive link I shared. For compliance: Monica will include a SOC2 summary and a link to the compliance pack in the pre-demo packet.

Next steps from our side:
1) I’ll send two calendar invites (tech + exec) once you confirm times.
2) Diego and I will highlight the 3 perf metrics Mariana asked for in the tech section.
3) Monica will prepare a short compliance + procurement checklist and attach SOC2 pointers.

If that matches your schedule I’ll create the invites.

Thanks — will coordinate invites ASAP.

—Karthik
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Attachment: agenda-v2.pdf
From: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Alice Nguyen <alice@helios.com>
Cc: Diego Fernandez <diego@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 27 Sep 2026 08:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Proposed 90m demo next Wed — CTO attendance?

Karthik / Alice — I can definitely lead the exec summary at 13:30 PT and will have a 2-slide ROI + pricing scenarios pack. I’ll also attach the SOC2 one-pager to the invite so procurement has what they need.

Diego — can you make sure the perf markers are on the first slide of your deck so Mariana sees them up front?

I’ll take the calendar action once Karthik drafts the invites.

Thanks,
Monica Patel
Director, Customer Solutions | Redwood Inference
From: Alice Nguyen <alice@helios.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Reed <tom.reed@helios.com>, Mariana Lee <mariana@helios.com>
Date: Sun, 27 Sep 2026 09:22:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Proposed 90m demo next Wed — CTO attendance?

Perfect — that plan works for us. Please send the two invites (10:00–11:00 PT and 13:30–14:00 PT) and include the recording permission. Also, please add the compliance one-pager and the MAP link in the invite so our procurement lead has visibility.

Looking forward to it — see you next Wednesday.

Alice
